title.narrative: Bihar State Highways II Project - Additional Financing

description.narrative: The project will expand the original Bihar State Highways II Project "Original Project" output by rehabilitating and upgrading about 254 km of state highways in Bihar identified under the Bihar State Highways Development Program (BSHDP). These severely deteriorated highway sections are located in the very poor north and south parts of the state. The project will involve upgrading existing roads to two lanes, strengthening existing pavement, strengthening culverts and bridges, and constructing new bridges and cross-draining structures. Consulting services are provided to supervise the implementation of civil works. Completion of spillover works under Loan 2663-IND: Bihar State Highways II Project (closed on 30 September 2018) for the construction and upgrading of about 389 km of state highways have been included under the scope utilizing the loan surplus.
